title: 第20课 · 我被他影响了
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 20 — 我被他影响了 · I've been influenced by him

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在休息室 — In the lounge

items.zh: 照相机
items.py: zhàoxiàngjī
items.en: camera

items.zh: 被
items.py: bèi
items.en: marks the passive voice

items.zh: 难过
items.py: nánguò
items.en: sad

items.zh: 东
items.py: dōng
items.en: east

items.zh: 信用卡
items.py: xìnyòngkǎ
items.en: credit card

items.zh: 小丽：我的照相机被谁拿走了？怎么找不到了？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ de zhàoxiàngjī bèi shéi názǒu le? Zěnme zhǎo bu dào le?
items.en: Xiaoli: Who took my camera? Why can't I find it?

items.zh: 同事：你再找找。是不是没带来？
items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐ zài zhǎozhao. Shì bu shì méi dàilai?
items.en: Colleague: Have another look. Maybe you didn't bring it?

items.zh: 小丽：我找了，没找到啊。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ zhǎo le, méi zhǎodào a.
items.en: Xiaoli: I looked, but I couldn't find it.

items.zh: 同事：别难过，再买一个吧，公司东门外不就有一个大商场吗？
items.py: Tóngshì: Bié nánguò, zài mǎi yī ge ba, gōngsī dōngmén wài bù jiù yǒu yī ge dà shāngchǎng ma?
items.en: Colleague: Don't be sad, just buy another one. Isn't there a big shopping mall right outside the company's east gate?

items.zh: 小丽：但是我这个月信用卡里的钱已经花得差不多了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Dànshì wǒ zhège yuè xìnyòngkǎ li de qián yǐjīng huā de chàbuduō le.
items.en: Xiaoli: But I've already spent almost all the money on my credit card this month.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.zh: 关心
items.py: guānxīn
items.en: to care for, to be interested in

items.zh: 只有……才……
items.py: zhǐyǒu……cái……
items.en: only… (then/can…)

items.zh: 成绩
items.py: chéngjì
items.en: grade, performance, achievement

items.zh: 小明：你怎么突然关心起体育来了？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Nǐ zěnme tūrán guānxīn qi tǐyù lai le?
items.en: Xiaoming: How come you've suddenly become interested in sport?

items.zh: 朋友：我的男朋友喜欢看足球比赛，我被他影响的。
items.py: Péngyou: Wǒ de nánpéngyou xǐhuan kàn zúqiú bǐsài, wǒ bèi tā yǐngxiǎng de.
items.en: Friend: My boyfriend loves watching football matches — I was influenced by him.

items.zh: 小明：看来只有爱，才能让人有变化。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Kànlái zhǐyǒu ài, cái néng ràng rén yǒu biànhuà.
items.en: Xiaoming: It seems only love can make people change.

items.zh: 朋友：是啊，为了和他的爱好一样，我天天看球赛。
items.py: Péngyou: Shì a, wèile hé tā de àihào yīyàng, wǒ tiāntiān kàn qiúsài.
items.en: Friend: That's right. To share his hobby, I watch matches every day.

items.zh: 小明：除了足球，他还影响你什么了？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Chúle zúqiú, tā hái yǐngxiǎng nǐ shénme le?
items.en: Xiaoming: Besides football, how else has he influenced you?

items.zh: 朋友：我最近天天上网玩儿游戏，我的成绩差极了。
items.py: Péngyou: Wǒ zuìjìn tiāntiān shàng wǎng wánr yóuxì, wǒ de chéngjì chà jí le.
items.en: Friend: Lately I play games online every day, and my grades are terrible.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在饭馆 — In the restaurant

items.zh: 碗
items.py: wǎn
items.en: bowl

items.zh: 分
items.py: fēn
items.en: to distinguish

items.zh: 朋友：那个拿着碗吃饭的人是你哥哥吗？他和你长得真像。
items.py: Péngyou: Nàge ná zhe wǎn chī fàn de rén shì nǐ gēge ma? Tā hé nǐ zhǎng de zhēn xiàng.
items.en: Friend: Is that person eating with a bowl in his hand your brother? You really look alike.

items.zh: 大卫：我们经常被别人认错。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒmen jīngcháng bèi biérén rèncuò.
items.en: David: People often mix us up.

items.zh: 朋友：只有你们的爸爸妈妈才能分出来哪个是哥哥，哪个是弟弟吧。
items.py: Péngyou: Zhǐyǒu nǐmen de bàba māma cái néng fēn chulai nǎge shì gēge, nǎge shì dìdi ba.
items.en: Friend: I guess only your parents can tell which one is the older brother and which one is the younger.

items.zh: 大卫：除了父母以外，还有我们自己也能啊。
items.py: Dàwèi: Chúle fùmǔ yǐwài, hái yǒu wǒmen zìjǐ yě néng a.
items.en: David: Apart from our parents, we ourselves can too!

items.zh: 朋友：你们两个除了长得像，还有什么相同的地方？
items.py: Péngyou: Nǐmen liǎng ge chúle zhǎng de xiàng, hái yǒu shénme xiāngtóng de dìfang?
items.en: Friend: Apart from looking alike, what else do you two have in common?

items.zh: 大卫：我们住在同一个楼、同一个房间……
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒmen zhù zài tóng yī ge lóu, tóng yī ge fángjiān……
items.en: David: We live in the same building, the same room…

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — Solving problems

items.zh: 解决
items.py: jiějué
items.en: to solve

items.zh: 试
items.py: shì
items.en: to try

items.zh: 真正
items.py: zhēnzhèng
items.en: really, truly

items.zh: 多么
items.py: duōme
items.en: very, to a great extent

items.zh: 年轻人遇到难题，常常很着急，不知道怎么办。
items.py: Niánqīng rén yùdào nántí, chángcháng hěn zháojí, bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.
items.en: When young people run into a difficult problem, they often get anxious and don't know what to do.

items.zh: 其实，不同的问题有不同的解决办法。
items.py: Qíshí, bù tóng de wèntí yǒu bù tóng de jiějué bànfǎ.
items.en: In fact, different problems have different solutions.

items.zh: 有些问题看上去很难，但是做起来非常简单，所以得试着做做。
items.py: Yǒuxiē wèntí kàn shangqu hěn nán, dànshì zuò qilai fēicháng jiǎndān, suǒyǐ děi shìzhe zuòzuo.
items.en: Some problems look hard but are very easy to do, so you have to give them a try.

items.zh: 有些问题看上去虽然简单，但是解决起来难极了。
items.py: Yǒuxiē wèntí kàn shangqu suīrán jiǎndān, dànshì jiějué qilai nán jí le.
items.en: Some problems look simple, but are extremely hard to solve.

items.zh: 所以只有真正做事情的时候，才能了解有多难。
items.py: Suǒyǐ zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng zuò shìqing de shíhou, cái néng liǎojiě yǒu duō nán.
items.en: So only when you actually do something can you understand how hard it is.

items.zh: 不过，我们一定要相信：多么难的问题，都会被解决的。
items.py: Bùguò, wǒmen yīdìng yào xiāngxìn: duōme nán de wèntí, dōu huì bèi jiějué de.
items.en: But we must believe that no matter how hard a problem is, it will be solved.
